rules.accepted_credit_types: CE from CCNE/ACEN-accredited nursing schools, bodies accredited by ANCC, ABSNC, AANPCB, ICE, NCCA or NCSBN, ACCME, ANA, ACPE or Joint Accreditation providers, and courses approved by the California or Florida boards
rules.new_licensee_rule: Nurses who graduated within 12 months before their first renewal are exempt; a new-graduate residency program completed in the biennium also satisfies the requirement.
rules.alternatives: 30 CE hours is one of nine options; one is enough. Others include a board-approved refresher course, 2 semester credits of post-licensure study, 120 hours as a preceptor, a nursing research or EBP project, a published article or chapter, developing and teaching nursing CE, a nurse residency program, or another activity pre-approved by the board. A current board-recognized national certification exempts the nurse.
rules.audit_note: Random audit after the June 30 deadline; selected names posted online; 60 days to submit proof; keep records at least 4 years.
rules.notes: All RN and LPN licenses expire June 30 of odd years (current biennium July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2027). Inactive licenses can be renewed without the requirement.
